key_findings: Oral NB001 (AC1 inhibitor) and AC1 knockout reduce neuropathic (CPN) and inflammatory (CFA) allodynia in adult female mice without side effects.
NB001 blocks induction but not maintenance of ACC LTP in female mice, without altering AMPA or NMDA receptor EPSCs.
